def geodesic_mix(lambda,a,b): theta=torch.acos((a*b).sum(dim=[1])).view(a.shape[0],1) n1=torch.sin(lambda*theta)/torch.sin(theta)*a n2=torch.sin((1-lambda)*theta)/torch.sin(theta)*b return n1+n2
